title: What if the 1859 solar storm hit today? ☀️
subject: sun
description:
Would your town keep the lights on? 👇

What would happen if a Carrington Event solar storm like 1859 hit Earth today? Power grids, satellites and GPS are at risk, and in 2012 a storm that strong missed us by about a week.

Sources: NASA Science ("Near Miss: The Solar Superstorm of July 2012"), USGS ("What a Solar Superstorm Could Mean for the US"), National Academy of Sciences report (2008) via NASA, Riley, Space Weather (2012) via NASA
tags: what if the carrington event happened today

scenes.text: In 1859, the Sun set telegraph offices on fire.
A solar storm lit auroras as far south as Cuba. Telegraph lines sparked.
Today, satellites would glitch and huge currents would surge into power grids.
Giant transformers could fail, and NASA says repairs might take years.
But here's the strange part. In July 2012, a storm that strong missed Earth by about 1 week.
